items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: Eleanor Roosevelt, Mrs. Franklin Delano Roosevelt was there, and she was to make a speech later... I politely turned around to Mrs. Roosevelt and asked her did she mind moving

ctx.x: Eleanor Roosevelt. So while she's doing this, at some time or another, the photographer winked at me and told me "Let's do it now" -- which meant that he was going to take my picture. I politely turned around to Mrs. Roosevelt and asked her did she mind moving; this gentleman was going to take my picture. And now I still have that picture, and it's a picture that reminds me til the day I die that if I ever thought I was smart, that was one time when I look at that picture, I know what a fool I was! Because I can…
